inputs.text: Canada is tightening immigration and asylum rules for Nigerians and others after Bill C-12, the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, received royal assent on March 26, 2026. A country has a duty to protect its borders and preserve public order; stronger rules are a necessary step toward restoring control over who enters and stays.
